title: Respectful Communication Skills (Father-Focused)
description: This course supports fathers to communicate respectfully with partners and children, reducing fear and improving emotional safety.
learningOutcomes: Learn respectful communication in parenting contexts.
Understand how listening supports children’s emotional needs.
Develop skills for expressing needs without aggression.
Recognise how communication shapes family safety.

modules.title: Fathering and Communication
modules.content: Explores how communication affects children’s emotional world.

modules.title: Safe Expression of Needs
modules.content: Provides tools for assertive, respectful communication.
